name: 🚍Diesel n' Steel
desc:
🔥 Diesel n' Steel: The ORIGINAL Jeepney Simulator!

Take the wheel and experience the hustle of Philippine public transportation!

🚍 Drive iconic Jeepneys across Bulacan
💵 Compete for passengers and earn cash
⚒️ Buy, upgrade & customize your ride
👥 Build your career from Driver to Operator

🌟 Do you have what it takes to become the King of the Road?

👍 Like & Favorite for more updates!

⚠️ Not affiliated with LTO, LTFRB, or DOTr.
